notes.title: World's Goodest Pup is part of Roguelike Celebration 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938545/800bf1279db5fbd3bef304d6dbdd099dd67d44a9.png[/img]

World's Goodest Pup is honored to be featured as part of Roguelike Celebration 2024! This is an amazing collection of released and upcoming roguelike games. So whether you're into procedural generation, random events, or deck building, this festival has you covered.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/roguelikecelebration2024]Go on over and check out all the amazing selections here![/url]
